title: Unicode-safe slugify() for HiveFund URLs
description: Implement an ES module slugify.mjs exporting slugify(input: string): string. It must turn arbitrary titles into URL slugs: lowercase ASCII letters and digits separated by single hyphens, no leading or trailing hyphens. Latin diacritics must be transliterated (é -> e, ß -> ss), other non-ASCII characters dropped. The automated test in bounties/tests/slugify.test.mjs is the acceptance gate.

criteria.description: Explains the normalization approach: unicode decomposition (NFKD), diacritic stripping, lowercase conversion, and collapsing separators into single hyphens.
Documents edge cases: empty input, repeated separators, leading or trailing punctuation, german sharp s, and non-latin characters.
